title: 连词成句 Build a Sentence
intro: 重排词/词组，组成合语法、且能恰当回应上句的句子。对/错判分——语序或语法错一处即算错。

items.prompt: What are you doing this weekend?
items.answer: I'm going to visit the science museum.
items.note: be going to + 动词原形，表已定的计划

items.prompt: Why didn't you answer my call?
items.answer: I was in a meeting at that time.
items.note: was + 介词短语，描述过去某时的状态

items.answer: I will finish it by Friday.
items.note: will + 动词原形；by + 时间点 = 不迟于

tokens: that is closer to the park
items.answer: I chose the one that is closer to the park.
items.note: that 引导定语从句，修饰 the one

items.answer: The lecture was so boring that I almost fell asleep.
items.note: so + 形容词 + that 结果状语从句

items.answer: I'm thinking about studying abroad for a master's degree.

items.prompt: Why do you prefer online classes?
items.answer: They allow me to study at my own pace.
items.note: allow sb to do = 允许某人做某事

items.prompt: Would you have come if you had known?
items.answer: If I had known, I would have come earlier.
items.note: 第三条件句：If + had done, would have done（与过去相反）

items.answer: The project was completed on time by everyone's effort.
items.note: 被动语态 was + 过去分词；by 引出施动者

items.prompt: What's your view on the deadline?
items.answer: The deadline is reasonable although it is tight.
items.note: although 引导让步状语从句

items.answer: The experiment was repeated to ensure that the results were reliable.
items.note: to ensure that... 目的状语 + 宾语从句

items.prompt: What surprised you about the study?
items.answer: What surprised me was that the researchers overlooked such an obvious factor.
items.note: What... 主语从句 + that 表语从句
